title: Enforcer Evidence Manifest
description: GT-511 / EAG-02. Auditable evidence emitted for one enforcer run. Its field set discharges every rule in rulesets/evidence/evidence-manifest.rules.json: EVD-01 identity (id, source, generatedAt, producer, relatedRuleIds|relatedGateId), EVD-02 traceability (sourceRef), EVD-03 integrity (status, evaluatedRules, blockingFailures, waiverRef), EVD-04 retention (retentionPeriod, owner). Mirrors packages/core-domain/src/evaluation/violation.ts.

sourceRef.description: EVD-02 resolvable ref to the command / CI run / artifact that produced it.

engine.$comment: GT-511 open vocabulary; enforcer evidence uses 'enforcer'.

relatedRuleIds.description: EVD-01 union of the ruleIds evaluated/violated (alternative to relatedGateId).

relatedGateId.description: EVD-01 gate this evidence supports (alternative to relatedRuleIds).

evaluatedRules.description: EVD-03 rules that were evaluated in this run.

blockingFailures.description: EVD-03 count of non-frozen error violations.

waiverRef.description: EVD-03 waiver reference when a failure is waived.

owner.description: EVD-04 accountable owner for audit follow-up.

violations.description: The normalized violations captured by this run.
